subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add a structured progress metrics contract to plugin hook events, and which runtime source owns `stepTotal`, `percent`, ETA, and terminal metrics across embedded, CLI, and Codex paths?
rationale: The code change is feasible, but progress semantics become public Plugin SDK behavior and automation should not invent misleading completion percentages or cross-runtime ownership rules.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and test each producer path that emits them.

options.title: Keep hooks unchanged
options.body: Leave plugins to derive progress from existing lifecycle and tool events, accepting text-only cards until a stronger progress source exists.

options.title: Create a dedicated progress event
options.body: Design a separate progress hook or agent-event projection instead of attaching percentages to tool and terminal hooks.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and test each producer path that emits them.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior public hook contract expansion and hook type split history make this the closest owner trail for the API direction decision.
